		out.close();
	}

	void solve() throws Exception {
		int k = Integer.parseInt(in.readLine());
		out.println(slow(k));
	}

	static final String BAD = "VK";

	String prepare(String s) {
		StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
		for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
			char c = s.charAt(i);
			if (BAD.indexOf(c) != -1) {
				sb.append(c);
			} else {
				sb.append('A');
			}
		}
		return sb.toString();
	}

	int slow(String s) {
		s = prepare(s);
		HashMap<String, Integer> map = new HashMap<>();
		ArrayDeque<String> que = new ArrayDeque<>();
		que.add(s);
		map.put(s, 0);

		while (true) {
			s = que.poll();
			int curD = map.get(s);
			if (s.indexOf(BAD) == -1) {
				return curD;
			}

			for (int i = 0; i < s.length() - 1; i++) {
				String nxt = swap(s, i, i + 1);
				if (nxt != null && !map.containsKey(nxt)) {
					map.put(nxt, curD + 1);
					que.add(nxt);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	String swap(String s, int i, int j) {
		if (s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(j)) {
			return null;
		}
		char[] buf = s.toCharArray();
		char tmp = buf[i];
		buf[i] = buf[j];
		buf[j] = tmp;
		return new String(buf);
	}

	String genStr() {
		int n = (int) (Math.random() * 15 + 1);
		char[] buf = new char[n];
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			buf[i] = BAD.charAt((int) (Math.random() * 2));
		}
		return new String(buf);
	}

	void stress() throws Exception {
		int k = 0;
		while (true) {
			String s = genStr();
			int fast = fast(k, s);
			int slow = slow(s);
			if (fast != slow) {

				out.println(fast);
				out.println(slow);
				throw new Exception("fast vs slow");

		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			a[i] = (BAD.indexOf(s.charAt(i)) != -1 ? 1 : 0);
			int c = a[i];
			cntHere[c][sz[c]] = pref[i].clone();
			pos[c][sz[c]++] = i;

			pref[i + 1] = pref[i].clone();
			pref[i + 1][c]++;
		}

		int[][][][] dp = new int[1][sz[0] + 1][sz[1] + 1][sz[2] + 1];

		for (int i = 0; i < 1; i++) {
			for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= sz[0]; j0++) {
				for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= sz[1]; j1++) {
					Arrays.fill(dp[i][j0][j1], Integer.MAX_VALUE);

						}

							int cost = Math.max(j0 - cntHere[1][j1][0], 0)
									+ Math.max(j2 - cntHere[1][j1][2], 0);
							dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2] = Math.min(

							dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1] = Math.min(
									dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1], curVal + cost);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

				}
			}
		}
	}

	String swap(String s, int i, int j) {
		if (s.charAt(i) == s.charAt(j)) {
			return null;
		}
		char[] buf = s.toCharArray();
		char tmp = buf[i];
		buf[i] = buf[j];
		buf[j] = tmp;
		return new String(buf);
	}

	String genStr() {
		int n = in.nextInt();
		char[] buf = new char[n];
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			buf[i] = "VK".charAt(in.nextInt() % 2);
		}
		return new String(buf);
	}

	int fast(int k, String s) {
		s = prepare(s);
		int n = s.length();
		int[] a = new int[n];
		int[][] pos = new int[3][n];
		int[] sz = new int[3];
		int[][][] cntHere = new int[3][n][3];
		int[][] pref = new int[n + 1][];
		pref[0] = new int[] { 0, 0, 0 };
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			a[i] = "VK".indexOf(s.charAt(i));
			int c = a[i];
			cntHere[c][sz[c]] = pref[i].clone();
			pos[c][sz[c]++] = i;
			pref[i + 1] = pref[i].clone();
			pref[i + 1][c]++;
		}
		int[][][][] dp = new int[2][sz[0] + 1][sz[1] + 1][sz[2] + 1];
		for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
			for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= sz[0]; j0++) {
				for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= sz[1]; j1++) {
					Arrays.fill(dp[i][j0][j1], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
				}
			}
		}
		dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;
		for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= sz[0]; j0++) {
			for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= sz[1]; j1++) {
				for (int j2 = 0; j2 <= sz[2]; j2++) {
					for (int last = 0; last < 2; last++) {
						int idx = j0 + j1 + j2;
						int curVal = dp[last][j0][j1][j2];
						if (curVal == Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
							continue;
						}
						if (idx == n) {
							return curVal;
						}
						if (j0 < sz[0]) {
							int cost = Math.max(j1 - cntHere[0][j0][1], 0)
									+ Math.max(j2 - cntHere[0][j0][2], 0);
							dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2] = Math.min(
									dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2], curVal + cost);
						}
						if (j1 < sz[1] && last == 0) {
							int cost = Math.max(j0 - cntHere[1][j1][0], 0)
									+ Math.max(j2 - cntHere[1][j1][2], 0);
							dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2] = Math.min(
									dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2], curVal + cost);
						}
						if (j2 < sz[2]) {
							int cost = Math.max(j0 - cntHere[2][j2][0], 0)
									+ Math.max(j1 - cntHere[2][j2][1], 0);
							dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1] = Math.min(
									dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1], curVal + cost);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
	}
